Hi Emma,

We need to finalize the Vendor Security Review before you move forward with the Paris-to-London flight. Could you check whether May 30, 2024 from 2:00-3:00 PM is free? If so, please create the event 'Vendor Security Review' with me (mark.black-2134@gmail.com) as a participant and 'Video Call' as the location. Once that's set, you can continue with the flight planning.

Thanks,
Mark
